text: Application: Xtreme aftermarket Porsche head programs, including 3.6 to 4.0 L Turbo. Component: cylinder head. The reviewed factual register records declared aluminum alloy as RR350. Evidence status: supplier_declared. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Supplier declaration. Not an OEM Porsche casting identification; exact chemistry and heat treatment not specified. Source locator: Our Programs, general manufacturing paragraph Research record: [MEZGER-M026].

Application: Xtreme aftermarket Porsche head programs, including 3.6 to 4.0 L Turbo. Component: cylinder head. The reviewed factual register records manufacturing and post-casting process as ["lost-wax investment casting","HIP"]. Evidence status: supplier_declared. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: Supplier declaration. HIP conditions, alloy certificate and local wall dimensions not supplied. Source locator: Our Programs, general manufacturing paragraph Research record: [MEZGER-M027].

Application: Original Porsche 993 Turbo M64/60. Component: cylinder head. The reviewed factual register records OEM exact alloy and chamber/port wall thickness as not established in this review. Evidence status: not_established_in_review. This record is qualified evidence; retain its application and uncertainty. Qualification: RR350 aftermarket heads do not identify original Porsche head alloy. No original-part wall dimensions established. Source locator: Aftermarket program page reviewed; original-part data absent Research record: [MEZGER-M033].
